The Sóno Hanoi Hotel perfectly located in Hanoi Old Quarter. It is ideally situated for visiting the Old quarter and most attractive points which the city has to offer such as Hoan Kiem Lake, Water Puppet Theatre, Dong Xuan Market, Opera House... Each of room has a distinct style, with beautifully appointed rooms and suites decorated in the style of Hanoi Life and Art. Stay at The Sóno Hanoi Hotel is unlike any other hotels in Hanoi, specially hotels in Hanoi's Old Quarter. An understated palette of subtle colours lends an air of calm to the spacious rooms and suites. Our acclaimed staff offers a unique style of heartfelt hospitality that is sincere, thoughtful and personal. The Sóno Hanoi Hotel is graciously served by hand-picked people , who are constantly ranked as the most dedicated and friendly in the town. More than an accommodation, we always share our guests the daily life and stype of Hanoian . With our uncharted service, you can enjoy your trip as a local. We would be honored to have your stay with us on your next visit to Hanoi, Vietnam.
